notes: The CelebA reliability whitelist (13 attributes) is the reliability ceiling.
This experiment subset further filters by FIUBench coverage.
Wearing_Hat and Wearing_Necktie have zero accepted positives — no positive experimental cases exist.
Sideburns has 63.8% uncertain labels — insufficient signal for reliable experimentation.
All 10 remaining attributes have both positive and negative examples across train/eval/exclude roles.
Male is retained as apparent-presentation analysis is part of the research question; treat strictly as CelebA-defined Male label.
